Image made by Snrasha

Com Relay Preview

When you access a nearby Com Relay...

Choose between two options.

The first challenge offers exclusive bounties - all available from the start, ready for any bold pilot to claim. No locks, no waiting. Just targets and glory.

The second? It's the endless battle - a pure end-game gauntlet where titanic fleets clash in brutal warfare. Survive the chaos and earn rewards worthy of a legend.

Changelogs:

Update History

Gladiator Society - Changelog & Update History

This post summarizes recent updates to ensure compatibility and expand gameplay features for Starsector v0.98a.

Version 1.5.0

- UX: Reward notifications now appear as proper intel messages in the bottom-left panel

- Credits, blueprints, ships, weapons, and fighter wings all show as intel entries

- Replaces the old plain chat messages for all reward types across all game modes

- UX: Bounty display now shows color-coded difficulty label (Easy/Medium/Hard/Extreme)

- CONTENT: Added 5 new bounty missions covering previously missing factions

- "Iron Faith" (Brother Kael) - Luddic Path zealot, fast and reckless

- "Diktat Enforcer" (Commander Voss) - Sindrian Diktat officer, steady and powerful

- "Persean Champion" (Mira Solenne) - Persean League commander, aggressive cruiser

- "Remnant Watcher" - Remnant patrol redirected to the arena (requires Derelict)

- "Ludd's Minister" (Minister Aldric) - Luddic Church pragmatist, cautious carrier

- CONTENT: Difficulty tiers added to all existing bounty missions

- CONTENT: Endless Battle rewards now cover every round up to 100 (was sparse after round 20)

- Added rewards for rounds 4, 17, 19, 21-24, 26-29, 31-34, 40, 45, 55, 65, 80, 100

- CONTENT: Faction pool for Endless/Fleet Battles expanded

- Added: Remnant, Luddic Path, Luddic Church, Sindrian Diktat, Lions Guard

- POLISH: Fixed text errors across multiple bounty missions

- MrBadaboum2: grammar fix ("have remade" -> "has remade")

- RandomGuys2: punctuation and capitalization fix

- Remnant: "for have kill" -> "for killing"

- LasherEpidemic: "searches to entertain" -> "seeks to entertain"

- Derelict2: removed duplicate word "of of"

- CONTENT: Added 3 new vanilla bounty missions (no mod dependencies required)

- "The Pack Leader" (Grak Bonecrusher) - pirate swarm fighter, unlocks after GotAProblem

- "Iron Wall" (Varro Ironwall) - retired Hegemony commander, slow but devastating

- "Phase Ghost" (Syla Vex) - Tri-Tachyon phase specialist, fast and unpredictable

- CONTENT: Added 6 new Endless Battle rewards for previously empty rounds

- Round 6: 3x Broadsword wings

- Round 7: 4x Light Autocannons

- Round 8: 2x Hypervelocity Drivers

- Round 16: Hammerhead blueprint

- Round 25: Eagle Cruiser blueprint

- Round 30: GladiatorSociety Samurai ship

- BALANCING: Fixed reward scaling being completely out of proportion with fleet strength

- Endless Battle: Credit formula changed from quadratic (3.0*power²+power*800) to linear (power*150+5000)

- Round 10 reward: was ~270k credits, now ~34k credits

- Round 20 reward: was ~1.93M credits, now ~107k credits

- Fleet Battles: Same fix applied (linear formula * 0.75 for ally support discount)

- Blueprint reward interval now scales with round: every 3 rounds (r1-9), every 5 (r10-29), every 8 (r30+)

- BUGFIX: Fixed Personality HullMods never working correctly (wrong PREFIX "autonomous_personality_" -> "GladiatorSociety_")

- BUGFIX: Fixed MISSIONBOUNTY and ENDLESSBATTLE constants being swapped in GladiatorSociety_Constants

- BUGFIX: Removed duplicate Commodities import in BlueprintRewardSystem

- BUGFIX: FleetBattleContent.shipRewardTaken was final, causing potential save/load issues

- Added readResolve() to guard against null after deserialization

- IMPROVEMENT: Added missing XStream aliases for BountyData, DataShip, EndlessReward dataclasses

- IMPROVEMENT: Added gladiatorsociety.version file for Version Checker mod support

- IMPROVEMENT: FactionDiscoveryConfig no longer loaded on every fleet creation

- POLISH: Fixed several text typos ("Comparaison" -> "Comparison", "Ennemi" -> "Enemy", "have be accepted" -> "has been accepted")

- POLISH: Fixed gender inconsistency in GotAProblem mission description

Version 1.3.6:

- Dynamic Faction Detection: conflict-safe validation so only factions that can actually generate combat fleets are included.- New config flags in data/config/gs_factions.json:  • validateUsingFleetGen (bool): toggle validation via tiny test fleets.  • validationFleetType (string): special fleet type used only for validation to avoid conflicts with other mods.  • vanillaModdedSplit (0.0-1.0): controls vanilla vs modded selection chance (default 0.5).- Validation fleets are hidden from gameplay and skip GS-specific interaction setup to reduce mod conflicts.- Endless Mode uses the configurable vanilla/modded split; modded factions have the same chance to spawn as vanilla by default.- Minor robustness: safer clamping and guards around config usage.

Version 1.3.5:

- Endless Mode: added null-safety when starting duels to prevent a rare crash if the enemy fleet could not be generated.- Added safe faction fallbacks (pirates -> independent) during fleet generation to increase robustness.- Shows a clear message and cancels gracefully if fleet generation still fails, instead of crashing.

Version 1.3.4:

- Dependencies: Requires Nexerelin. LazyLib has been added as a dependency but is not yet used.- Fleet Battles improvements: allied fleet now reliably spawns and joins battles alongside the player.- Deployment points now correctly count allied ships on the player side.- Fleet Battles reward flow: periodic blueprint rewards and random unique ship rewards based on defeated enemy composition.- Credit rewards in Fleet Battles slightly reduced vs Endless to account for ally support.- Stability fixes in fleet spawning and improved diagnostic messages.- Dynamic Mod Faction Detection: runtime scan of all loaded factions (vanilla + modded), filtered via data/config/gs_factions.json.- 50/50 vanilla vs modded faction selection for both Fleet Battles and Endless Mode, with robust fallbacks.- Auto-refresh of discovered factions when mods are added/removed.- Endless Mode now uses the dynamic faction pool for enemy selection.- Improved spawn robustness and null-guards to avoid crashes.

Version 1.3.3:

- Removed the old dialog-based reward system- Rewards now given automatically when reaching specific rounds- Fixed ship rewards not being properly added to the player's fleet- 20% chance to receive duplicate rewards- Progressive reward system: higher-value rewards more likely in later rounds- Improved feedback messages- Better error handling and logging- Optimized code performance- Removed the "Reward" button- Ships now added directly to fleet (not just blueprints)- Proper handling of hull IDs and variant IDs

More content is planned - future updates will be added to this list as development progresses.

[close]
